notes: Rule 3 sanity check passed: live storefront, Impressum shows genuine registration (Hoeffner Online Beteiligungs-GmbH, HRB 10594 Amtsgericht Cottbus, VAT DE275390878, named Geschaeftsfuehrer), no closing-down language; consistent with the known real Hoeffner furniture chain (part of the XXXLutz Group, same group as S.N. 115 XXXLutz DE in this batch, but on its own distinct hoeffner.de storefront/domain -- not checked for product-ID overlap with XXXLutz since that worker's JSON was not yet available at extraction time). ACCESS: direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF/blocking encountered, no proxy needed. NAV SOURCE: server-rendered mega-menu on the homepage (React/Emotion markup), read via BeautifulSoup on element ids Lampen (Lighting) and Deko (Decor); Bad (Bathroom) menu for bathroom mirrors; Haushalt (Household) menu for glassware/tableware. Also checked Moebel, Buero, Kueche, Kinder, Garten, Textilien, BettenMatratzen menus -- no further in-scope categories found there (furniture/appliances/textiles only). QTY VERIFICATION (Rule 1): every listing page embeds an SSR JSON payload with an explicit totalCount and numberOfPages field, and the rendered header always read 'N Ergebnisse' -- both signals agreed on every category checked (dual-signal match used as primary evidence). Page size is a stable 72 products/page. Ran the stronger last-page exhaustion check (unique articleNo count on the final page) on a deliberate size/section spread -- Deckenleuchten (847 = 11x72+55), Haengeleuchten (817 = 11x72+25), Teller (210 = 2x72+66), Dekoartikel (275 = 3x72+59) -- all four reconciled exactly, and every single-page category's on-page unique articleNo count equalled its totalCount exactly (e.g. Akkuleuchten 32=32, Bilderrahmen 47=47, Badezimmer-Spiegel 40=40). No inflation was found anywhere on this platform, unlike the Shopify/Magento/Constructor.io precedents in Rule 1 -- Hoeffner's totalCount is trustworthy. EXCLUDED as mixed roll-ups (Rule: drop, don't pad): Einzelgeschirrteile (704, individual-tableware-pieces roll-up whose own listed siblings Teller/Schalen/Tassen/Becher/etc are already extracted separately and roughly sum to it); Gartendekoration (18, mixes genuine garden decor -- solar lanterns, garden gnomes, bird bath -- with actual furniture items Beistelltisch/Serviertisch side tables, no clean URL-level split available). EXCLUDED per Home Fragrance rule: Kerzen/kerzen-teelichter (85, candles node) -- product-title check found ~28-34 of 85 are Duftkerze (scented candles) via the Produkttyp/Duft facets, with no separate unscented-only URL to cleanly split on, so the whole node was dropped; the sibling Kerzenstaender (candle holders) and Teelichthalter (tea light holders) nodes were kept since they are holders, not candles, and showed no scent contamination. EXCLUDED as bar tools/kitchen tools: Weinzubehoer (9, wine coolers/bottle openers/corkscrews/kitchen scissors -- functional bar tools, not glassware, despite living under the Glaeser menu). EXCLUDED throughout: Leuchtmittel (light bulbs), Lagerraeumung (clearance/liquidation, appears as a repeated menu item, not a real category), Papeterie (stationery), Kunstblumen (artificial flowers), Geschenkartikel and its children (gifts), all bathroom furniture/storage/hardware under Bad except Badezimmerspiegel, all storage/Aufbewahrung, all appliances, cookware, cutlery (Messer und Besteck), textiles, and all furniture (Moebel/Garten/Kinder/Bueromoebel menus in full). RULE 0 GAIN: included Aussenleuchten (Outdoor Lighting, 54) and Kinderleuchten (Kids Lighting, 51) purely on product-type grounds despite the room/context words 'Aussen' (outdoor) and 'Kinder' (children) in their names; also kept Badezimmerspiegel (Bathroom Mirrors, 40) as a genuine second mirror listing alongside the main Spiegel (Mirrors, 264) node rather than treating 'Bad' as a blanket exclusion -- documented as a legitimate overlap under Rule 0.6 since the two live in separate site nav branches (Deko vs Bad) with no evidence of being the same URL/listing. Also kept Deko-Schalen (Decorative Bowls, 85, under Deko) alongside Schalen (Bowls, 145, under Haushalt/tableware) as a second genuine overlap -- different departments, same product-type logic applies (Rule 0.6). Kept Uhren (Clocks, 24) despite the menu label 'Uhren & Wetterstationen' (Clocks & Weather Stations): product-title check found 23/24 are wall/table/mirror clocks and only 1 is a functional kitchen Digital-Timer -- treated as acceptable site-reported contamination rather than a true mixed roll-up given the overwhelming majority are genuine clocks. Kept Getraenkezubereitung (Beverage Preparation Glassware, 10) as mostly glass drinking-straw sets (glass accessories, explicitly in scope) with one arguable Eiswuerfelbehaelter (ice cube container) outlier. Category field buckets used: Lighting, Wall Decor & Mirrors, Home Decor, Kitchen & Dining (with nested Glassware and Tableware & Dinnerware parent rows).
